note: The transcriptions read in reader/, one per copy (item of the catalogue) they were made on. copies: the items of the catalogue that show this same scan (the own item included, also one not in the catalogue yet), each with its offset: canvas number (#p, from 1) = page of the transcription + offset. released: the catalogue shows the link to everybody (false: only to admins; the reader still opens for anyone with a direct link). ink: how the viewer frees the writing from the paper (paper and ink: grey values; red: drop Durand's red Quốc Ngữ). The Bookshelf (js/shelf.js) shows a card for every text that is released (admins: all), sorted in among the other works: cover (an IIIF image, optional), summary {en, vi} (optional); a text copied by Maurice Durand gets the ribbon of his collection.

summary.en: An old tale of Lord Thao, a Nôm poem in lục bát verses, copied by hand with the reading in Quốc ngữ under every character.
summary.vi: Truyện xưa về chúa Thao, một truyện thơ Nôm theo thể lục bát, chép tay với âm đọc quốc ngữ dưới từng chữ.
